newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - U.S. Can coverage begins.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - U.S. Can coverage begins.

text.p: McDonald & Co analyst Tim Burns said Thursday he began coverage of U.S. Can Corp with an aggressive buy rating and a 12-month price target of $22 a share.

-- On Wednesday, U.S. Can announced a restructuring plan. Burns said these actions will more than offset an estimated loss of $35.0 million in sales after S.C. Johnson, a major aerosol can customer, awarded its business to a U.S. Can competitor. The company also announced it was seeking a successor for Chairman William Smith, who is retiring.
-- U.S. Can said it hired Salomon Brothers Inc to assist it in evaluating strategic alternatives. The analyst said this make indicate that "a takeover, hostile or otherwise, could be imminent."

-- "We believe USC will retain its premier position as a leading supplier of aerosol, specialty and general line cans as well as metal services despite the loss of the highly visible S.C. Johnson account," Burns added.
